products.name: Loom AI
products.note: Async video AI; auto-chapters; summaries; transcription; Atlassian acquisition context

profile_text.body:
Loom describes itself as a free online screen recording tool for Mac and PC, offering video editing and video storage, and states it is trusted by over 22 million people. The platform is positioned around asynchronous video communication, allowing users to record walkthroughs and share them quickly.

On the AI side, Loom offers a product called Loom AI, which provides features including automatic chapters, summaries, and transcription. The company's site highlights an integration with Jira, whereby Loom's AI can take a recorded walkthrough and convert it into a populated Jira work item, automatically capturing technical details such as device, browser, operating system, console errors, and network activity. The held facts note this product in the context of an Atlassian acquisition.
